command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (Feature Mixer harness)

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.AccountsTest.test_account_rules
tests.expected: bad emails, short passwords, unknown roles and duplicate emails are rejected

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.AccountsTest.test_session_expires_after_idle_timeout
tests.expected: a session unused for more than 30 minutes is ended

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.AccountsTest.test_sign_in_and_wrong_password
tests.expected: the right password starts a session for that user; a wrong one is refused with 401

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.AccountsTest.test_unified_roles_and_approve_permission
tests.expected: owners and admins manage users; members do not; approving needs the approve permission

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.ApprovalsTest.test_approval_journey
tests.expected: approvers are told about a request, the decision is recorded, and the requester is told

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.ApprovalsTest.test_approval_rules
tests.expected: members without the permission cannot decide, nobody decides their own request, and a decision is final

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.ApprovalsTest.test_pending_approval_blocks_closing
tests.expected: a task cannot be moved to done while its approval is pending, and can once it is decided

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.CommentsTest.test_comment_rules
tests.expected: empty comments, replies across items and comments on missing items are rejected

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.CommentsTest.test_threaded_comments_on_tasks_and_approvals
tests.expected: replies nest under their parent, the parent's author is notified, and approvals take comments too

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.DashboardTest.test_workload_counts
tests.expected: open tasks per person exclude done ones, overdue counts open tasks due before today (UTC), pending approvals are counted

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.DatabaseTest.test_integrity
tests.expected: foreign keys and checks hold: no approval for a missing task, deleting a task removes its approvals, no unknown roles

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.HttpApiTest.test_api_errors
tests.expected: no session gives 401, bad JSON gives 400, an unknown path gives 404, a wrong method gives 405, all in one error format

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.HttpApiTest.test_end_to_end_journey
tests.expected: an owner adds people, a member creates and assigns a task, asks for approval, an approver approves after a threaded discussion, the task closes, and every step shows up in notifications and the dashboard

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.HttpApiTest.test_push_subscription_over_http
tests.expected: a signed-in user can register an https push endpoint over the API

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.HttpApiTest.test_sign_out
tests.expected: after signing out the old session cookie no longer works

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.NotificationEngineTest.test_preferences_choose_channels
tests.expected: turning email off stops email deliveries; in-app always arrives

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.NotificationEngineTest.test_push_channel_for_opted_in_browsers
tests.expected: after opting in, a notification also queues a push to each subscribed browser; http endpoints are refused

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.NotificationEngineTest.test_read_and_privacy
tests.expected: a user can mark their own notification read, and cannot see or touch anyone else's

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.TasksTest.test_assignee_must_exist
tests.expected: assigning to an unknown user is rejected

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.TasksTest.test_assignment_notifies_on_every_channel_once
tests.expected: the assignee gets one in-app notification and one queued email, even if assigned twice

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.TasksTest.test_no_notification_for_assigning_yourself
tests.expected: assigning a task to yourself sends nothing

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.TasksTest.test_only_allowed_people_move_tasks
tests.expected: someone who is not the creator, assignee, owner or admin cannot move a task

tests.name: tests.test_teamhub.TasksTest.test_task_board_flow
tests.expected: a task starts in todo, moves to doing and done, and rejects unknown statuses and bad titles
